items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: Wake with Lawrence and wake with John too. ... What kind of a clarinet player was Georgie Boyd? John Boyd was a pretty good clarinet player. ... Well yeah his style was more rough than I was.

ctx.x: He was lively and still, you know.

Well on the stand, on the music stand, he stood lively. He stayed there and he danced on them drums and he had everything going and his temper was there and he never nausea out. Never get up on that cymbal and swing your eye on him, man. He worked that cymbal in there, he stood there dancing on him, he exploded like a fool and bust out and laughed. He said, he said, how about you, brother-in-law, let's go. He's gone now. Last time my son, I said no, he said he ain't playing nothing, just one or two tunes, he…
I don't know, but many of them wake with...
